evalconfig.description: Evaluates HCL configuration source code in "Just Attributes" mode, returning an object representing the attributes.

parameters.name: src
parameters.description: The source code of the HCL native syntax configuration to parse and evaluate.

parameters.name: specfile
parameters.description: Path to the file containing the hcldec specification describing how to interpret the configuration.

parameters.name: vars
parameters.description: An object describing any additional variables to include in the evaluation scope.

evalconfigattrs.description: Evaluates HCL configuration source code in "Just Attributes" mode, returning an object representing the attributes.

parameters.name: src
parameters.description: The source code of the HCL native syntax configuration to parse and evaluate.

parameters.name: vars
parameters.description: An object describing the variables to include in the evaluation scope.

evalexpr.description: Evaluates a given string as an HCL expression.

parameters.name: src
parameters.description: The source code of the expression to evaluate.

parameters.name: vars
parameters.description: An object describing the variables to include in the evaluation scope.

evaltemplate.description: Evaluates a given string as an HCL template.

parameters.name: src
parameters.description: The source code of the template to evaluate.

parameters.name: vars
parameters.description: An object describing the variables to include in the evaluation scope.
